posts.cooked: I’ve had the Enhanced Edition for a few months, so I figured it was time to jump into some expansions. I wanted my FLGS to get RC/IR, Shattered Timelines, Unity, and Ambuscade. All their distributor had was Unity, though, and they didn’t know when they’d get more of anything, as >G was out too. I saw in another thread that Shattered Timelines is down to what they have in stock for the webstore, so I assume these other things are in the same situation. Has anyone heard anything about another print run? I would just order from >G (I’d love to directly support them, and I’m sure shipping would be reasonable since I only live 100 miles from St. Louis) but I’m using store credit to get them, so that’s not really an option. Thanks in advance to anyone who may know of anything.

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: Actually... we are basically out of everything except mini-expansions in our warehouse. We have a few copies left still for conventions and for selling on our web store, but I've been turning down distributors for nearly a month now. Fortunately, most things are in the process of being reprinted, but unfortunately, RC/IR is not likely to be back in stock for distributors until late July / early August.
